metadata.description: Personal Claude Code skills for verification, code review and engineering judgment.

plugins.name: verification
plugins.description: Skills that give Claude evidence-based feedback loops: a project verify skill that runs the real app, property and differential tests, flaky-test triage, diff-triggered reliability checks and a pre-PR check.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Lightweight review helpers that work with the built-in /code-review: a REVIEW.md that tells the reviewer what failure looks like, and evidence-backed PR write-ups.

plugins.name: critical-thinking
plugins.description: Reasoning tools for engineering decisions: argument and self-critique, bias and option checks, rival causes for debugging and incidents, outside-view estimates and premortems.

plugins.name: team-review
plugins.description: Review governance for teams that merge many agent-written PRs: risk-based approval tiers, review-gate audits, reviewer evals built from incidents, and turning recurring misses into rules. Assumes CODEOWNERS, several reviewers and an incident history.
